definition_zh: 银河系的；星系的；银河系尺度的；极大的（口语夸张）
definition_en: of or relating to a galaxy, especially the Milky Way, or to the whole star system that contains the sun
core_image: 一枚从侧面看去的旋涡盘，中心鼓起，几条旋臂向外拖开，盘面薄得像一张纸
scene: 夜里没有月光的山顶，一条灰白色光带横过天顶，望远镜正对着它的中心方向。Above the ridge, a faint band of light marks the galactic plane.
sceneCN: 这里 galactic 指「与银河系盘面有关的」（第 3 个义项：用于银河系中心、盘面、银晕等结构术语）；句意为山脊之上一条淡淡光带标出了银河系盘面。图中可辨识物件：无月的夜空、乳白光带、指向天顶的望远镜、山脊轮廓、星点。

pos.zh: 银河系的；星系的；（口语）极大的、银河级的

collocations.zh: 银河年（太阳绕银心一周）

senses.title: Belonging to the Milky Way
senses.definition: relating to the Milky Way, the galaxy that contains the sun and its planets
senses.definitionCN: 与包含太阳及其行星的银河系有关的
senses.example: Dust clouds hide the galactic centre from optical telescopes.
senses.exampleCN: 尘埃云使光学望远镜看不见银河系中心。
senses.why: the adjective was formed in English from galaxy plus -ic, and its first and still central use is to name the one galaxy we live inside.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词由 galaxy 加 -ic 在英语中构成，最早也最核心的用法就是称呼我们身处的这个星系。

senses.title: Belonging to galaxies in general
senses.definition: relating to galaxies as a class of objects rather than to the Milky Way alone
senses.definitionCN: 指作为一类天体的星系，而非仅指银河系
senses.example: Galactic surveys map how star formation changes from galaxy to galaxy.
senses.exampleCN: 星系巡天描绘出恒星形成如何从一个星系到另一个星系发生变化。
senses.why: once astronomers knew that many such star systems exist, the same adjective was extended from one proper name to the whole class.
senses.whyCN: 当天文学家确认这类恒星系统有许多个之后，同一个形容词便从一个专名扩展到了整个类别。

senses.title: Structural terms of a galaxy
senses.titleCN: 银河系结构的术语用法
senses.definition: used in fixed compounds that name the parts of a galaxy, such as plane, centre, disk, bulge and halo
senses.definitionCN: 用于「盘面、中心、盘、核球、银晕」等固定搭配，指星系的各个结构部分
senses.example: Above the ridge, a faint band of light marks the galactic plane.
senses.exampleCN: 山脊之上，一条淡淡的光带标出了银河系盘面。
senses.why: a galaxy is a flattened system, so astronomers name its geometry the way geographers name a globe: plane, centre, disk, halo.
senses.whyCN: 星系是一个扁平的体系，因此天文学家像地理学家描述地球那样给它命名：盘面、中心、盘、晕。

senses.title: The galactic year
senses.titleCN: 银河年：太阳绕银心一周的时长
senses.definition: used in the phrase galactic year for the time the sun takes to travel once around the Milky Way's centre
senses.definitionCN: 用于 galactic year，指太阳绕银河系中心运行一周所需的时间
senses.example: One galactic year is roughly two hundred and thirty million earthly years.
senses.exampleCN: 一个银河年大约是两亿三千万个地球年。
senses.why: the adjective turns a duration into a galactic one: the same idea of a year, measured around a different centre.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词把一段时长换算到星系尺度：同样是「一年」的概念，只是绕另一个中心来计量。

senses.title: Halo, bulge and dark matter
senses.titleCN: 银晕、核球与暗物质语境
senses.definition: used of the faint outer and inner parts of a galaxy that are studied through stars, gas and gravity
senses.definitionCN: 指星系外围与内部那些通过恒星、气体和引力来研究的暗淡部分
senses.example: The galactic halo holds old stars and most of the galaxy's dark matter.
senses.exampleCN: 银晕容纳着老年恒星以及该星系的大部分暗物质。
senses.why: these parts emit little light, so they are named by position and studied indirectly, which is why the adjective appears so often beside them.
senses.whyCN: 这些部分发出光很少，只能按位置命名并间接研究，因此这个形容词常与它们同现。

senses.title: Enormous, on a cosmic scale
senses.titleCN: 夸张用法：极大的、银河级的
senses.definition: used informally for something enormous or far-reaching, as if measured on the scale of a galaxy
senses.definitionCN: 口语中形容某事物极其巨大或影响深远，仿佛以星系为尺度衡量
senses.example: The paperwork failure was a galactic mistake rather than a small one.
senses.exampleCN: 那次文书失误不是小错，而是一场银河级的大错。
senses.why: the adjective imports the largest unit speakers know, so it works as a hyperbole for size rather than as an astronomy term.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词借用了说话者所知最大的单位，于是成为夸张尺寸的说法，而非天文学术语。

senses.title: Science-fiction settings
senses.definition: used in fiction for empires, fleets or federations that span a whole galaxy
senses.definitionCN: 在虚构作品中指横跨整个星系的帝国、舰队或联邦
senses.example: The novel opens with a galactic empire losing contact with its outer worlds.
senses.exampleCN: 小说开篇写一个银河帝国与它的外围世界失去联系。
senses.why: fiction needs a word for the largest political unit imaginable, and the astronomical adjective supplies it without inventing anything.
senses.whyCN: 虚构作品需要一个词来形容想象中最大的政治单位，而天文学形容词正好提供了它，无须另造新词。

senses.title: Old sense: of milk
senses.definition: formerly meaning 'of milk', a sense kept only in the word's history and in related scientific terms
senses.definitionCN: 旧时意为「乳汁的」，此义仅存于词史与相关科学术语中
senses.example: The older medical sense of galactic survives only in etymological notes.
senses.exampleCN: galactic 古老的医学义「乳汁的」只保留在词源注释里。
senses.why: the Greek source galaxias meant 'milky', so the adjective once belonged to milk before astronomy took it over.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语源头 galaxias 意为「乳色的」，因此这个形容词在被天文学接管之前曾属于「奶」。

intro.en: Galactic comes from Greek galaxias (kyklos) 'the milky circle', from gala, galaktos 'milk', with the English suffix -ic. The astronomical sense was fixed in the nineteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: galactic 来自希腊语 galaxias（kyklos）「乳色的圆环」，源于 gala、galaktos「奶」，加英语后缀 -ic。天文学义在 19 世纪固定下来。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek galaxias meant 'milky', used of the pale band across the night sky; the full phrase was galaxias kyklos, 'the milky circle'.
items.cn: 希腊语 galaxias 意为「乳色的」，用于指夜空中那条淡白光带；完整说法是 galaxias kyklos「乳色的圆环」。

items.en: The root is gala, galaktos 'milk'. The same element appears in galactose, a sugar once obtained from milk.
items.cn: 词根是 gala、galaktos「奶」。同一成分出现在 galactose 中，那是一种最初从奶中取得的糖。

items.en: Latin calqued the Greek phrase as via lactea 'the milky way', literally 'the milky road', which is the source of the English name Milky Way.
items.cn: 拉丁语把希腊短语仿译为 via lactea「乳色的路」，字面是「奶做的路」，这就是英语名称 Milky Way 的来源。

items.en: English formed galactic from the Greek stem in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, as telescopes resolved the band into stars and then into a disk of stars.
items.cn: 英语在 18 至 19 世纪用希腊词干构成 galactic，正值望远镜把那条光带解析为恒星、再解析为一个恒星盘。

items.en: Twentieth-century astronomy extended the adjective to every galaxy, and popular speech borrowed it for anything enormous.
items.cn: 20 世纪的天文学把这个形容词扩展到所有星系，日常口语又借它来形容任何巨大的事物。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Greek origin of gala is not settled, and the Indo-European form often cited for 'milk' is a reconstruction rather than a recorded word.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：gala 在希腊语之前的来源尚无定论，常被引用的那个表示「奶」的印欧形式属于重构形式，而非有记录的词。

note.en: Group one holds words sharing the same galactic stem; group two holds adjectives of the sky that are close in use but not in root.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 galactic 词干的词；第二组是用法相近但词根不同的天空类形容词。

entries.definition: The noun from which galactic is formed: a gravitationally bound system of stars, gas and dust.
entries.definitionCN: 构成 galactic 的名词：由引力束缚的恒星、气体与尘埃系统。

entries.definition: Inter- 'between' plus galactic: belonging to the space between galaxies, not inside one.
entries.definitionCN: inter-「之间」加 galactic：属于星系之间的空间，而非星系内部。

entries.definition: Extra- 'outside' plus galactic: lying beyond our own galaxy, as extragalactic nebulae do.
entries.definitionCN: extra-「在外」加 galactic：位于我们星系之外，如河外星云。

entries.definition: From Greek gala 'milk' plus -ose, the sugar suffix; it shares the milk root but has no astronomical meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 由希腊 gala「奶」加糖类后缀 -ose 构成；共享「奶」的词根，但没有天文学含义。

entries.definition: Relating to the universe as a whole, from Greek kosmos 'order'; wider than galactic, which stops at one galaxy.
entries.definitionCN: 与整个宇宙有关，来自希腊 kosmos「秩序」；比只到星系一级的 galactic 更广。

entries.definition: Relating to astronomy, or informally to numbers too large to grasp; it names the discipline, not the galaxy.
entries.definitionCN: 与天文学有关，口语中也指数值大得难以想象；它指学科，而非星系。

entries.definition: Relating to stars, from Latin stella; a galactic system is made of stars, but the words mark different levels.
entries.definitionCN: 与恒星有关，来自拉丁 stella；星系由恒星组成，但两词标示的层级不同。

entries.definition: Belonging to the sky or heavens, from Latin caelum; it covers everything overhead, galactic or not.
entries.definitionCN: 属于天空或天界，来自拉丁 caelum；涵盖头顶一切，无论是否属于星系。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real compounds and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Greek gala 'milk' + -ic: the Milky Way was named for looking like a stream of milk.
normal.cn: 希腊 gala「奶」+ -ic：银河得名于它看上去像一道奶流。

normal.en: Latin said via lactea 'milky road', which English copied as the Milky Way.
normal.cn: 拉丁语说 via lactea「奶做的路」，英语照抄为 the Milky Way。

normal.en: The family runs galaxy, galaxies, galactic, intergalactic, extragalactic.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 galaxy、galaxies、galactic、intergalactic、extragalactic。

normal.en: Fixed compounds place it in astronomy: galactic centre, galactic plane, galactic halo.
normal.cn: 固定搭配把它固定在天文学中：银河系中心、银河系盘面、银晕。

normal.en: One galactic year is the sun's own orbit around the galaxy's centre.
normal.cn: 一个银河年就是太阳绕星系中心自己的一圈。

abstract.en: Picture a fried egg seen edge-on: a bright yolk and a thin white disk.
abstract.cn: 想象一只侧看过去的煎蛋：亮的蛋黄与薄薄的蛋白盘。

abstract.en: Picture a clock so large that its single tick lasts a human lifetime.
abstract.cn: 想象一只大得离谱的钟，一次滴答就耗尽人的一生。

abstract.en: Picture a city map where the streets are spiral arms and the centre is a crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象一张城市地图，街道是旋臂，中心是一片人潮。

examples.en: Radio telescopes can see through the dust that hides the galactic centre.
examples.cn: 射电望远镜能穿透遮住银河系中心的尘埃。

examples.en: The team measured the galaxy's mass from the motion of its galactic halo.
examples.cn: 团队根据银晕的运动测出了该星系的质量。

examples.en: A galactic year is far longer than any human record.
examples.cn: 一个银河年远比任何人类记录都要长。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「尬了（gala）＋克体（-ctic）」——银河大得让人尴尬地磕巴 → 银河系的

root: 希腊 galaxias（kyklos）「乳色的圆环」= gala、galaktos「奶」+ 形容词后缀 -ic；拉丁仿译为 via lactea，英语据此称 the Milky Way。gala 更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one widening ring: the Milky Way's own adjective, then galaxies as a class, then their named parts, then a year measured around a centre, then the unseen halo, then sheer size, fiction and finally the word's milky past.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一圈逐步扩大：先是我们所在银河系的形容词，再是作为类别的星系，再是其各部分的名称，然后是绕中心计量的一年，接着是看不见的银晕，再到纯粹的巨大、虚构设定，最后回到这个词与「奶」的旧缘。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin bright disk seen edge-on, with a swollen centre and arms dragging outward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个侧看过去的薄亮盘面，中心鼓起，旋臂向外拖开。

branches.en: ONE AND MANY: the same adjective names our galaxy and then any galaxy.
branches.cn: 一个与许多：同一个形容词先指我们的星系，再指任何星系。

branches.en: MAP OF A DISK: plane, centre and halo are directions on the same flattened system.
branches.cn: 盘面地图：盘面、中心与银晕是同一个扁平体系上的方位。

branches.en: CLOCK AROUND A CENTRE: a year redefined by what it goes around.
branches.cn: 绕中心的钟：把「一年」按所绕的中心重新定义。

branches.en: BORROWED MAGNITUDE: speech and fiction take the largest unit as a figure of speech.
branches.cn: 借来的量级：口语与虚构作品把最大的单位借作修辞。

branches.en: MILKY ORIGIN: the name was about milk before it was about stars.
branches.cn: 乳色源头：这个名字先与奶有关，后来才与恒星有关。

intro.en: Galactic is a Greek stem plus an English adjective suffix; the stem also builds the noun galaxy and several compounds.
intro.cn: galactic 是希腊词干加英语形容词后缀；同一词干还构成名词 galaxy 及若干复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin kept the same milk image in lac 'milk', lacteus 'milky' and via lactea 'the milky road', the direct model of the English name.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语用 lac「奶」、lacteus「乳色的」与 via lactea「奶做的路」保留了同一幅奶的意象，后者正是英语名称的直接模板。

items.example: The root names the pale band the Greeks thought looked like milk.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根命名了希腊人觉得像奶的那条淡白光带。

items.meaning: belonging to; of the nature of
items.example: The suffix turns the noun galaxy into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把名词 galaxy 变成形容词。

items.example: A faint band marks the galactic plane.
items.exampleCN: 一条淡光带标出银河系盘面。

items.example: The galaxy contains billions of stars.
items.exampleCN: 这个星系包含数十亿颗恒星。

items.example: Distant galaxies look like faint smudges.
items.exampleCN: 遥远的星系看上去像淡淡的小污点。

items.example: Intergalactic gas is extremely thin.
items.exampleCN: 星系际气体极其稀薄。

items.example: Extragalactic astronomy began with nebula debates.
items.exampleCN: 河外天文学始于关于星云的争论。

items.example: The two clouds are galactically close.
items.exampleCN: 这两团云在星系尺度上算得很近。

items.meaning: a sugar once derived from milk
items.meaningCN: 一种最初从奶中取得的糖
items.example: Galactose is part of lactose.
items.exampleCN: 半乳糖是乳糖的组成部分。

latinEntries.structure: lacteus, lactea, lacteum (adj., first and second declension)
via lactea (noun phrase, first declension + adjective)
latinEntries.meaning: the Milky Way, literally 'the milky road'

definition_zh: 银河；银河系（太阳系所在的星系）
definition_en: the galaxy that contains the solar system, seen from inside as a faint band of light across the night sky
core_image: 一条乳白色光带斜跨整个夜空，带中夹着暗尘裂成的缝，下方是山的黑轮廓
scene: 夏夜的山谷里，头顶那条乳白光带从一座山脊拖到另一座山脊，肉眼看不清其中的星点。From the valley, the Milky Way appears as a pale band of light between the ridges.
sceneCN: 这里 the Milky Way 指「夜空中肉眼可见的那条乳白光带」（第 2 个义项：从星系内部看到的银河光带）；句意为从山谷望去，银河像两道山脊之间的一条淡白光带。图中可辨识物件：山谷、两道山脊、乳白光带、暗尘裂缝、稀疏星点。

pos.zh: 银河；银河系（专有名词，通常带定冠词 the）

collocations.phrase: the centre of the Milky Way
a band of the Milky Way

collocations.zh: 在银河之下（多用于文学）

derivatives.zh: 银河系（天文学同义称呼）

senses.title: The galaxy we live in
senses.definition: the large system of stars, gas and dust that contains the sun and the solar system
senses.definitionCN: 包含太阳与太阳系的巨大恒星、气体与尘埃系统
senses.example: The sun lies about twenty-six thousand light-years from the centre of the Milky Way.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳距离银河系中心约两万六千光年。
senses.why: the name first described a band in the sky, and only later was it attached to the whole system that produces that band.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字最初描述天上的一条光带，后来才被赋予产生这条光带的整个系统。

senses.title: The visible band in the night sky
senses.titleCN: 夜空中可见的乳白光带
senses.definition: the pale luminous band seen across the sky from inside the galaxy, made of countless unresolved stars
senses.definitionCN: 从星系内部看到的横跨天空的淡白光带，由无数未能分辨的恒星组成
senses.example: From the valley, the Milky Way appears as a pale band of light between the ridges.
senses.exampleCN: 从山谷望去，银河像山脊之间的一条淡白光带。
senses.why: because we sit inside a flat disk of stars, that disk is seen edge-on and projects onto the sky as a band.
senses.whyCN: 因为我们身处一个扁平的恒星盘内部，这个盘被侧着看，投影到天上就成了一条光带。

senses.title: A barred spiral structure
senses.definition: the shape of the system: a central bar, spiral arms, a thin disk and a surrounding halo
senses.definitionCN: 该系统的形状：中央棒、旋臂、薄盘与外围银晕
senses.example: Radio maps show a bar across the middle of the Milky Way.
senses.exampleCN: 射电图谱显示银河系中部横着一根棒。
senses.why: twentieth-century surveys revealed the bar and arms, so the name came to denote a structured object rather than a glow.
senses.whyCN: 20 世纪的巡天揭示出棒与旋臂，于是这个名字指称一个有结构的物体，而非一团光。

senses.title: Its centre and central black hole
senses.definition: the dense central region, about twenty-six thousand light-years away, which hosts a supermassive black hole
senses.definitionCN: 致密的中心区域，距我们约两万六千光年，其中有一个超大质量黑洞
senses.example: Stars near the Milky Way's centre swing around an unseen massive object.
senses.exampleCN: 银河系中心附近的恒星绕着一个看不见的巨大天体摆动。
senses.why: the centre is where the bar and the densest star clouds meet, so it naturally became a named place once orbits could be measured.
senses.whyCN: 中心是棒与最密恒星云相交之处，因此一旦能测量轨道，它自然成了一个有名字的地点。

senses.title: One member of the Local Group
senses.titleCN: 本星系群中的一个成员
senses.definition: one of the large galaxies in the Local Group, bound gravitationally to Andromeda and dozens of smaller galaxies
senses.definitionCN: 本星系群中的大星系之一，与仙女座星系及数十个较小星系受引力束缚
senses.example: The Milky Way and Andromeda are the two largest galaxies of the Local Group.
senses.exampleCN: 银河系与仙女座星系是本星系群中最大的两个星系。
senses.why: the name stopped being the whole universe once other galaxies were proved to lie outside it, so it now marks one member of a group.
senses.whyCN: 当其他星系被证明位于它之外，这个名字就不再等于整个宇宙，而是标记一个群体中的一员。

senses.title: Its naming and the milk myth
senses.definition: the name's origin in Greek galaxias kyklos 'milky circle' and the later story that it was spilled divine milk
senses.definitionCN: 名称源自希腊语「乳色的圆环」，以及后来把它说成洒出的神奶的故事
senses.example: Greek writers called the band the milky circle long before anyone knew what it was.
senses.exampleCN: 早在人们知道它是什么之前，希腊作家就称这条光带为乳色的圆环。
senses.why: the myth explains the name rather than the object: it accounts for why the band looked like milk, not for what produced it.
senses.whyCN: 这个神话解释的是名称而非天体：它说明这条光带为何像奶，而不说明是什么产生了它。

senses.title: The Great Rift and observing conditions
senses.definition: the dark lanes of dust that split the band, visible only from sites far from city light
senses.definitionCN: 把光带分割开的暗尘通道，只有在远离城市灯光的地点才看得见
senses.example: City glow washes out the Milky Way, so the rift can only be seen from dark sites.
senses.exampleCN: 城市的光害把银河冲淡，因此只有到黑暗的地点才看得见那条暗尘带。
senses.why: the band is faint, so what observers call 'the Milky Way' depends on where they stand, a fact the dust lanes make obvious.
senses.whyCN: 这条光带很暗，因此观测者所说的「银河」取决于他站在哪里，而暗尘带使这一点变得明显。

senses.title: The tautology 'Milky Way galaxy'
senses.titleCN: 教材里的同义重复「Milky Way galaxy」
senses.definition: the common textbook phrase in which galaxy repeats what the proper name already implies
senses.definitionCN: 教材中常见的说法，其中 galaxy 重复了这个专名已含的意思
senses.example: Textbooks write the Milky Way galaxy to make the category explicit for beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 教材写作 the Milky Way galaxy，是为了让初学者明确它属于哪一类。
senses.why: a proper name that has become opaque invites a classifying noun beside it, so the redundant phrase is a teaching device rather than an error.
senses.whyCN: 当一个专名变得不透明时，人们会在旁边补一个类别名词，因此这一冗赘说法是教学手段而非错误。

intro.en: Milky Way is an English calque of Latin via lactea, itself a calque of Greek galaxias kyklos 'the milky circle'. The English phrase is recorded from the late Middle Ages. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: Milky Way 是拉丁 via lactea 的英语仿译，而拉丁语又是希腊 galaxias kyklos「乳色的圆环」的仿译。这一英语说法见于中世纪末期。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek observers named the band galaxias kyklos, 'the milky circle', from gala 'milk' and kyklos 'circle, ring'.
items.cn: 希腊观测者把这条光带命名为 galaxias kyklos「乳色的圆环」，由 gala「奶」与 kyklos「圆环」构成。

items.en: A later myth said the band was milk spilled from Hera while she nursed Heracles; this is a story told to explain the name, not the name's source.
items.cn: 后来的神话称这条光带是赫拉哺育赫拉克勒斯时洒出的奶；这是为解释名称而讲的故事，并非名称的来源。

items.en: Latin poets translated the Greek phrase as via lactea, 'the milky road', keeping the milk image and changing circle to road.
items.cn: 拉丁诗人把希腊短语译作 via lactea「奶做的路」，保留奶的意象，把「圆环」换成了「路」。

items.en: English borrowed the Latin phrase word for word as Milky Way, first as a name for the band in the sky.
items.cn: 英语把拉丁短语逐词借入，成为 Milky Way，最初用作天上那条光带的名称。

items.en: From Galileo onward the band was resolved into stars, and by the twentieth century the name meant the whole star system.
items.cn: 自伽利略起，这条光带被解析为恒星；到 20 世纪，这个名字已指整个恒星系统。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the earliest English use of the exact phrase is not firmly dated, and the pre-Greek origin of gala remains unsettled, so any older form offered is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这一确切短语最早的英语用例没有可靠年代，而 gala 在希腊语之前的来源亦无定论，凡为其给出的更早形式均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds the alternative names and the derived adjective; group two holds wider sky words that are close in use but different in scope.
note.cn: 第一组是别名与派生形容词；第二组是用法相近但范围不同的天空类词。

entries.definition: The general noun for any such star system; the Milky Way is one galaxy, so the two words differ in scope rather than meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指任何这类恒星系统的名词；银河系只是其中一个星系，因此两词差别在范围而非含义。

entries.definition: The adjective built from galaxy, used for parts and scales of the Milky Way rather than for the whole name.
entries.definitionCN: 由 galaxy 构成的形容词，用于银河系的各部分与尺度，而非整个名称。

entries.definition: A capitalised synonym used in astronomy for the Milky Way, especially when contrasting it with other galaxies.
entries.definitionCN: 天文学中大写使用，作为银河系的同义称呼，尤用于与其他星系对照时。

entries.definition: The small cluster of galaxies that includes the Milky Way and Andromeda; it is the next larger unit, not a synonym.
entries.definitionCN: 包含银河系与仙女座的小星系群；它是更大一级的单位，不是同义词。

entries.definition: The universe as an ordered whole, from Greek kosmos; far wider than one galaxy.
entries.definitionCN: 作为有序整体的宇宙，来自希腊 kosmos；比一个星系广得多。

entries.definition: An imaginary globe on which the stars appear to sit; the Milky Way is a band drawn on that globe.
entries.definitionCN: 想象中恒星似乎附着其上的天球；银河是画在这个球上的一条带。

entries.definition: The nearest large spiral galaxy, often compared with the Milky Way; it is a separate system, not a part of it.
entries.definitionCN: 最近的大型旋涡星系，常与银河系相比；它是独立的系统，不属于银河系。

entries.definition: A dense visible patch of stars within a galaxy; the Milky Way contains many such clouds but is not one.
entries.definitionCN: 星系内部一片肉眼可见的密集恒星区；银河系含许多这样的云，但它本身不是一片云。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real compounds, real astronomy and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的复合词、真实的天文学与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: milk + way: the sky's milk-coloured road, copied from Latin via lactea.
normal.cn: milk + way：天上那条奶色的路，抄自拉丁 via lactea。

normal.en: The name first meant the band, then the whole galaxy that produces it.
normal.cn: 这个名字先指光带，后指产生光带的整个星系。

normal.en: The family runs galaxy, galactic, intergalactic, extragalactic.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 galaxy、galactic、intergalactic、extragalactic。

normal.en: Astronomers often write the Galaxy with a capital letter for the same object.
normal.cn: 天文学家常用大写 the Galaxy 指同一个天体。

normal.en: Its two largest neighbours are Andromeda and the Magellanic Clouds.
normal.cn: 它最大的两个邻居是仙女座星系与麦哲伦云。

abstract.en: Picture a lampshade seen from inside: its edge becomes a ring of light.
abstract.cn: 想象从灯罩内部看灯罩：它的边缘就成了一圈光。

abstract.en: Picture a river of milk crossing a black field, with dark stones parting it.
abstract.cn: 想象一条奶的河横过黑田野，黑石头把它分开。

abstract.en: Picture a city so large that its own lights look like a street from within.
abstract.cn: 想象一座大到从内部看自己的灯只剩一条街的城市。

examples.en: On a clear night far from towns, the Milky Way arches from horizon to horizon.
examples.cn: 在远离城镇的晴夜，银河从地平线拱到地平线。

examples.en: The Milky Way is a barred spiral with four main arms.
examples.cn: 银河系是一个有四条主旋臂的棒旋星系。

examples.en: Dust in the Milky Way's disk hides the centre from visible light.
examples.cn: 银河系盘中的尘埃使可见光看不见它的中心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「米尔奇（milky）＋威（way）」——天上一条奶白色的路 → 银河

root: 英语仿译拉丁 via lactea「奶做的路」，而拉丁又仿译希腊 galaxias kyklos「乳色的圆环」＝ gala「奶」+ kyklos「圆环」。gala 更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the whole system to the band it makes, then through its bar, centre, group and name, and end with how it is observed and how textbooks repeat it.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从整个系统走到它投出的光带，再经过它的棒、中心、星系群与名称，最后落到如何观测它、教材又如何重复它。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pale milky band laid across a dark sky, with dark lanes cutting through it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条乳白色光带铺在暗夜天上，暗色通道从中切过。

branches.en: SYSTEM AND ITS GLOW: the object and the band are the same thing seen from inside.
branches.cn: 系统与其光：天体与光带是从内部看同一件事。

branches.en: STRUCTURE: bar, arms and centre give the glow a shape and a middle.
branches.cn: 结构：棒、旋臂与中心给这团光一个形状与一个中点。

branches.en: MEMBERSHIP: it is one galaxy among neighbours, not the whole universe.
branches.cn: 成员身份：它是邻居中的一个星系，而非整个宇宙。

branches.en: WHY THE NAME: milk explains the look, myth explains the name.
branches.cn: 名称的来由：奶解释了外观，神话解释了名称。

branches.en: SEEING AND SAYING: the band depends on the observer, and the textbook phrase repeats the category.
branches.cn: 看与说：光带取决于观测者，教材短语则重复了类别。

intro.en: Milky Way is a two-word English compound, and each half is transparent: milk plus the adjective suffix -y, and way as 'road, route'.
intro.cn: Milky Way 是一个由两个词构成的英语复合词，两半都透明：milk 加形容词后缀 -y，以及 way 作「路、路线」。

latinIntro.en: The compound calques Latin via lactea; Latin lac 'milk' and lacteus 'milky' supply the same image, and Greek gala supplies the older root.
latinIntro.cn: 这个复合词仿译拉丁 via lactea；拉丁 lac「奶」与 lacteus「乳色的」提供同一意象，更早的词根则来自希腊 gala。

items.example: The band was named for its milk-like colour.
items.exampleCN: 这条光带因其似奶的颜色而得名。

items.example: Milky means having the look of milk.
items.exampleCN: milky 意为具有奶的样子。

items.example: Latin used the same road image: via lactea.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语用了同一个「路」的意象：via lactea。

items.meaningCN: 银河：银河系可见的光带
items.example: The Milky Way arches over the desert.
items.exampleCN: 银河拱在沙漠上空。

items.example: Our galaxy holds hundreds of billions of stars.
items.exampleCN: 我们的星系拥有数千亿颗恒星。

items.example: Galactic dust reddens distant starlight.
items.exampleCN: 银河系尘埃使远处星光偏红。

items.example: Intergalactic space is almost empty.
items.exampleCN: 星系际空间几乎是空的。

items.example: Extragalactic nebulae were once mistaken for clouds.
items.exampleCN: 河外星云曾被误认为云气。
